blocks.text: You can add domains on the Seeds Management page to run frequent scans on them to detect vulnerabilities for external attack surfaces. The Risk360 service then quantifies the risk determined on various parameters on exposed assets for potential breach and visualizes them as factors on the Factors page.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Legacy Admin Management > Risk360.
In the Domains field, click Upload File.
Click Download CSV Template. A CSV template for uploading the domains is downloaded to your device.
Update the file with the list of domains that you want to scan for external attack surface analysis. You can add up to 10 domains.
Click Upload File, go to the file on your device, and select the file.
After a successful upload message is displayed, click Save.
If an error message is displayed, ensure that the domains are added in the correct format in the CSV file and reupload the file.
The Seeds Management page displays all the domains from the CSV file. The Risk360 service takes up to 24–48 hours to scan and analyze the domains.
